glass: large rocks glass (about 300 ml), one large ice cube
notes: v1 (round 3): the Vieux Carré at Oxford's measures (pdf 2102: 30/30/30, 5 ml Bénédictine, 2 dashes each), which are Arthur's 1937 thirds (⅓ jigger each, ½ tsp Bénédictine, 1 dash each) doubled. One change: the sweet vermouth is steeped with green cardamom overnight (Codex pp. 95, 288). Stirred, strained over one large cube (LI p. 130). Lemon peel only; Oxford's cherry left off.
